rationale: The update introduces several security-relevant behavioral changes, including seven hardcoded IP additions, three dynamic-execution indicators, six source-to-sink heuristic indicators, substantial network churn, and extensive structural modifications. Although the overall network destination count decreased, many new external network indicators appeared, so this represents significant behavioral change rather than a simple expansion. No new permissions, host-scope expansion, or newly added sensitive API categories were introduced, and no independent public evidence confirms malicious intent or exfiltration. Therefore, the transition is assessed as RISKY_TRANSITION rather than MALICIOUS_TRANSITION.
